[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png]

And, '0 is written as 0'.

**And, '7 is written as -7'.**

So, 'VERB' will be coded as '-7'.

Hence, the correct answer is "-7".

questions.question:
Which two numbers (not digits) should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

5 - 6 ÷ 3 × 9 + 1 = 0
questions.solution:
Given equation: 5 - 6 ÷ 3 × 9 + 1 = 0.

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) 1 and 0

Given: 5 - 6 ÷ 3 × 9 + 1 = 0

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 5 - __**6 ÷ 3**__ × 9 + 0 = 1

⇒ 5 - __**2 × 9**__ + 0 = 1

⇒ __**5**__ - 18 __**+ 0**__ = 1

⇒ __5 - 18__ = 1

⇒ - 13 ≠ 1

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) 6 and 9

Given: 5 - 6 ÷ 3 × 9 + 1 = 0

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 5 - __**9 ÷ 3**__ × 6 + 1 = 0

⇒ 5 - __**3 × 6**__ + 1 = 0

⇒ __**5**__ - 18 __**+ 1**__ = 0

⇒ __6 - 18__ = 0

⇒ - 12 ≠ 0

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

**Option 3) 5 and 9**

Given: 5 - 6 ÷ 3 × 9 + 1 = 0

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 9 - __**6 ÷ 3**__ × 5 + 1 = 0

⇒ 9 - __**2 × 5**__ + 1 = 0

⇒ __**9**__ - 10 __**+ 1**__ = 0

⇒ __10 - 10__ = 0

**⇒ 0 = 0**

**⇒ LHS = RHS**

Option 4) 6 and 3

Given: 5 - 6 ÷ 3 × 9 + 1 = 0

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 5 - __**3 ÷ 6**__ × 9 + 1 = 0

⇒ 5 - __**0.5 × 9**__ + 1 = 0

⇒ __**5**__ - 4.5 __**+ 1**__ = 0

⇒ __6 - 4.5__ = 0

⇒ 1.5 ≠ 0

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: Which among the following is the correct way to express change of inventories of a firm during a year?

options.text: Change of inventories of a firm during a year (value added – intermediate goods used by the firm + sale of the firm during a year)
Change of inventories of a firm during a year (value added + intermediate goods used by the firm + sale of the firm during a year)
Change of inventories of a firm during a year (value added – intermediate goods used by the firm – sale of the firm during a year)
Change of inventories of a firm during a year (value added + intermediate goods used by the firm – sale of the firm during a year)

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Change of inventories of a firm during a year (value added + intermediate goods used by the firm – sale of the firm during a year).**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Point__**

 
• The correct way to express the change of inventories of a firm during a year is by calculating the inventory turnover or by using the formula for the change in inventories.
 
 
• **Inventory Turnover:**

 
 
• Inventory turnover is a financial ratio that measures the number of times a company's inventory is sold and replaced during a given period.
 
• It is calculated by dividing the cost of goods sold (COGS) by the average inventory value.
 
• The formula for inventory turnover is:
 
 
• **Inventory Turnover = Cost of Goods Sold / Average Inventory**
 
 
 
 
 
• **Change in Inventories::-**
 
 
• The change in inventories can be calculated by subtracting the ending inventory value from the beginning inventory value.
 
• The formula for the change in inventories is:
 
 
• **Change in Inventories = Ending Inventory - Beginning Inventory**
 
• This measure represents the net increase or decrease in inventory over a specific period, such as a year. A positive value indicates an increase in inventory, while a negative value suggests a decrease.
